title: Atom app goals — canonical reference index
scope: All original app goals; single-tenant main web app first, mobile last. This index is not a completion claim.

reference_order.purpose: Complete original 143-claim inventory and 18 goal rows. Preserve claim identifiers and historical evidence.
Later operational progress and source-bound evidence. Read dated updates in order; old open PR snapshots are historical.
Engineering/product delivery rules and agent responsibilities.

explicit_user_requirements: Long-running domain-independent jobs can wait for missing information for days, survive restart, continue independent useful work, and resume the same job when authorized relevant information arrives.
Agent graduation to autonomy requires verified evidence, appropriate approval, and enforceable authority boundaries.
BYOK chooses eligible models by measured satisfactory outcomes and expected cost; capable Flash models remain first-class.
Requested outputs must be usable, current, source-bound and verified; unresolved required outcomes cannot falsely complete or publish partial final artifacts.
Documentation, architecture diagrams and the marketing README must reflect verified capabilities and disclose limits.
Mobile follows main web readiness; completing a core release does not erase the remaining original app goals.
update_rules: Each delivery references original claim/goal, exact product source, evidence and remaining gap.
Distinguish implemented, submitted, merged, independently verified and full outcome acceptance.
Preserve negative evidence and historical counts; do not infer universal capability from bounded tests.
New user requirements append to the goal register rather than silently replacing existing scope.
